name: Twisted molybdenum ditelluride bilayer system
equilibrium_context: Ferromagnetic Chern insulator and fractional Chern insulator at zero field, with a fractionally quantized anomalous Hall effect
summary: The most stable topological observable in the register and the only non-volatile topological state.

driven_states.emergent_property: Helicity-selective optical pumping controls the ferromagnetic polarization and thereby the sign of the Chern number and the chirality of the edge states. At low power, optical training; at higher power, direct switching far below the Curie temperature; spatially resolved writing of Chern and fractional Chern domains.
driven_states.source: Holtzmann, Li, Anderson, Cai, Park et al., Nature 649, 1147 (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09777-3
driven_states.caveat: The most stable topological observable in the register (quantized or fractionally quantized Hall resistance), but the drive does not act on the band topology; it acts on the magnetic order that fixes its sign. No Floquet, no light-induced Chern number out of a trivial initial state. The authors do not entirely exclude an accompanying local heating contribution during switching. One group, 2026.

threshold.quantity: direct switching of the full polarization, detuning-dependent

driven_states.measured_quantity: quantized anomalous Hall resistance, magnetic circular dichroism, helicity-resolved photoluminescence

gaps: The drive acts on the magnetic order, not on the band topology.
